name: Media Viewer
description: Video and audio in Orca's editor tabs: plays .mkv, .mka and .weba, which Orca cannot show, and adds a full player view to .mp4, .mov, .webm, .mp3, .flac and other media. Speed, frame stepping, repeat, frame snapshots, file info and keyboard shortcuts.

cover.alt: Media Player in an Orca tab: a paused clip of a sunset over hills, with the seek bar, volume, speed, repeat, snapshot, fit, info and full screen controls below.
